```{r print_text, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

pasta_pub_img <- sprintf('%s/imgs', getwd())
dir.create(pasta_pub_img, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("\\centering\n")  # This centers the content below
cat("# ", params$title, "\n\n")
for (block in params$text_blocks) {
  cat(block, "\n\n")
}
```

```{r first_image, out.width="100%", fig.margin=FALSE}

if ('imagepath_0' %in% names(params) && file.exists(params$imagepath_0)) {
  # Copiar imagens para pasta temporária (para rodar quarto)
  img_local_0 <- file.path(pasta_pub_img, basename(params$imagepath_0))
  if (!file.exists(img_local_0)) {
    file.copy(params$imagepath_0, img_local_0, overwrite = TRUE)  
  }
  
  # warning('Hara 0')
  # cat("\\vspace{0.1cm}\n")  # You can adjust '1cm' to whatever space is needed
  # knitr::asis_output("\\vspace{-1cm}")  # Reduces space between the images
  knitr::include_graphics(img_local_0)
} else {
  cat("Image not found:", params$imagepath_0)
}

```

```{r second_image, out.width="100%", fig.margin=FALSE}
# Inserir segunda imagem, se coluna imagepath_1 existir no dataframe
if ('imagepath_1' %in% names(params) && file.exists(params$imagepath_1)) {
  # Copiar imagens para pasta temporária (para rodar quarto)
  # warning('Hara 1')
  img_local_1 <- file.path(pasta_pub_img, basename(params$imagepath_1))
  if (!file.exists(img_local_1)) {
    file.copy(params$imagepath_1, img_local_1, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  
  knitr::include_graphics(img_local_1)  # Display the second image
} else {
  # cat("Image not found:", params$imagepath_1, "\n")
  cat("\n")
  # warning('Haro 2')
}
```
